requirements.title: Exactly 1500 deterministic scenarios
requirements.requirement: P8 combinatorial qualification must execute exactly 1500 deterministic scenarios at one exact source SHA and authority fingerprint.

requirements.title: Per-process lower bound
requirements.requirement: Every one of the 27 process codes must receive at least 42 combinatorial scenarios.

requirements.title: Priority-core density
requirements.requirement: Each of the 11 priority computational processes must receive at least 72 combinatorial scenarios.

requirements.title: System-wide cross-process set
requirements.requirement: Exactly 36 scenarios are reserved for cross-process/system-wide combinations such as shared sources, revision mutation, selector invalidation, stale publication, concurrency and closure behavior.

requirements.title: 100 percent legal pairwise coverage
requirements.requirement: Across the declared factor model, every legally compatible factor-value pair must appear in at least one executable scenario; excluded pairs require an explicit machine-readable incompatibility reason.

requirements.title: Targeted high-risk 3-wise coverage
requirements.requirement: High-risk interactions in the priority computational core must include targeted legal 3-wise combinations, especially cardinality x composition x shared-resource, operating-case x evidence x reserve/policy, and topology/order x mutation x upstream-evidence interactions.

requirements.title: Order semantics qualification
requirements.requirement: Order-invariant inputs must produce identical canonical input/output hashes and engineering results under canonical reorderings, while order-significant paths/sequences must change canonical input meaning when the physical order changes.

requirements.title: Boundary cardinality qualification
requirements.requirement: Capacity-oriented processes must include limit-1, exact-limit and limit+1 cardinality scenarios wherever a finite process limit exists; zero/one/two/small-many cardinalities are also required when legally applicable.

requirements.title: Composition identity preservation
requirements.requirement: Homogeneous, heterogeneous, branched, shared-trunk, multi-role and cross-discipline shared compositions must preserve canonical physical identity so aliases or repeated logical roles cannot manufacture or remove capacity/load.

requirements.title: Mutation and invalidation qualification
requirements.requirement: Add/remove/reorder/rewire/revision/replay/stale scenarios must prove exact affected closure, deterministic recomputation, historical immutability and guarded publication.

requirements.title: No random-coverage claim
requirements.requirement: Unseeded random generation cannot satisfy combinatorial acceptance; scenario generation, constraints, pair coverage and targeted 3-wise inventory must be deterministic and versioned.

requirements.title: Separate qualification layer
requirements.requirement: The 1500 combinatorial matrix supplements rather than replaces the 54 primary public verticals, 135 dossier vectors and 450 market-shaped design scenarios.
